items.exampleEn: Many pilgrims visit this old town every year.
items.exampleZh: 每年都有很多朝聖者來這座古鎮。
items.glossZh: 朝聖者；長途步行的旅人

items.exampleEn: In the movie, a spaceship lands in a field.
items.exampleZh: 在電影裡，一艘太空船降落在田野上。

items.exampleEn: I bought a guidebook to Japan.
items.exampleZh: 我買了一本日本旅遊指南。

items.exampleEn: The tram is slower than the bus.
Sightseeing is my favorite part of a trip.
items.exampleZh: 觀光是我旅行中最喜歡的部分。

items.exampleEn: There is a big roundabout near my home.
items.exampleZh: 我家附近有一個大圓環。

items.exampleEn: Petrol is expensive in this country.

items.sentenceEn: Turn left at the next roundabout.

items.audioEn: Take the number five tram and get off at the museum.
items.audioZh: 搭五號路面電車，在博物館站下車。

items.sentenceEn: My guidebook says this castle is very old.
items.sentenceZh: 我的旅遊指南說這座城堡非常古老。

items.sentenceEn: We went sightseeing all day and got very tired.
items.sentenceZh: 我們觀光了一整天，累壞了。

items.stemEn: Let's go ____ in the old town this afternoon.
items.stemZh: 我們今天下午去老城區觀光吧。

items.stemEn: The car needs ____. Let's stop at the next town.
items.stemZh: 車子需要加油了，我們在下一個城鎮停一下吧。

items.passageEn: Last year, Leo visited Europe for the first time. He used a guidebook to plan his sightseeing. In one city, he took an old tram to the center. He also walked part of a road that pilgrims used long ago. When he rented a car, he had trouble with the roundabouts, and he almost ran out of petrol!
items.passageZh: 去年，Leo 第一次去歐洲。他用旅遊指南規劃觀光行程。在其中一座城市，他搭了一輛老舊的路面電車到市中心。他還走了一段很久以前朝聖者走過的古道。他租車的時候，不太會走圓環，還差點沒油！

questions.questionZh: Leo 用什麼規劃觀光行程？
Leo 開車時遇到什麼麻煩？
options: 在高速公路上被警察攔了下來
車子在停車場倒車時撞到了牆
不太會走圓環，還差點沒油

items.promptZh: 我弟弟想搭太空船去月球。
referenceEn: My little brother wants to go to the moon in a spaceship.
My younger brother wants to fly to the moon in a spaceship.
rubricZh: 「太空船」用 spaceship；「搭太空船」可寫例如 in a spaceship、by spaceship
主詞第三人稱單數，動詞加 s（例如 wants）

items.instructionZh: 用 guidebook 造一個句子，說說你旅行時怎麼用旅遊指南。
referenceEn: I always read a guidebook before a trip.
I use my guidebook to find good restaurants.
rubricZh: guidebook 是可數名詞（例如 a guidebook、my guidebook）
時態配合句意（例如 read、use）
